name: International Business Machines Corporation
research_rationale: Unchanged filings and stable Q3 snapshot metrics support the franchise case, but recent sentiment on price, consulting and leverage neither confirms a stronger buy nor overturns accumulate.

weekly_updates.summary:
News since mid-September emphasises share weakness, technical selling and modest consulting growth, with mixed institutional flows; commentary also cites software ARR and Microsoft AI-agent partnership themes.
No new SEC filing bodies appear in the library since the September structured verdict; conviction still rests on prior H1 2026 filings plus screening inputs.
Q3 2026 snapshot data show revenue roughly flat quarter-on-quarter (~$17.1bn) and positive operating free cash flow, without a clear filing-backed change to the debt or pension picture.
